sources.title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD), which leverages a pre-trained, specialized teacher model to provide dense supervisory signals, has achieved significant success in Large Language Models (LLMs) and has recently been adapted to flow matching models. sources.snippet: Lightning OPD is a new on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that trains a state-of-the-art reasoning model in as little as 30 GPU hours on a single node of 8 H100s, achieving 69.9% on AIME 2024 at the 8B scale, matching or surpassing standard OPD across all benchmarks while running 3.6x-4.0x faster and fully eliminating the need for a live teacher server during training. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms.
